packageRules.description: Keep cli/golangci-lint.mod on its own branch. A Renovate artifact update takes its whole config from the upgrade that sorts first on the branch. One branch per modfile keeps each goGetDirs and post-upgrade task on the file it names.

Keep cli/gotestsum.mod on its own branch. A Renovate artifact update takes its whole config from the upgrade that sorts first on the branch. One branch per modfile keeps each goGetDirs and post-upgrade task on the file it names.

Keep cli/govulncheck.mod on its own branch. A Renovate artifact update takes its whole config from the upgrade that sorts first on the branch. One branch per modfile keeps each goGetDirs and post-upgrade task on the file it names.

Keep cli/buf.mod on its own branch, and regenerate the proto stubs after a bump. No code imports buf. The code it emits links google.golang.org/protobuf, which cli/go.mod keeps, and buf's own dependencies stay out of cli/go.mod.

Tidy cli/go.mod after a Go bump, so go.sum holds the module-content (h1:) hashes too. A job that compiles cli/ without them fails with `missing go.sum entry`. The option reaches cli/go.mod because each Go modfile has its own branch (see the rules above), so keep those branches apart.

Regenerate cli/proto/gen when a generator module moves. cli/buf.gen.yaml runs protoc-gen-go and protoc-gen-connect-go from cli/go.mod, so the generated code matches the runtime it links. The regeneration lands on the bump's own branch, which generated-go-cli checks.

customManagers.description: Keep the nvm installer URL in the developer guide on nvm's latest release. The guide pins it because nvm publishes its installer per tag.
